snippet.title: Of Peaks and Tides Concept Trailer | Before the Fall
snippet.description:
In harmony, they lived. In the surging tide of war, the tribes fell.
The divine wrath scarred the mortal lands. Calamities rose, beasts ran rampant, and order collapsed.
Lands broke. Lives faded. You awakened.
Gather your companions. Explore the ancient wilds. Reclaim your land, and reforge what was lost.
Your legend begins here.
